d:
For centuries, poets have given voice to the human heart, shaping the language of love. carries that legacy forward as an intimate tribute rooted in India’s poetic tradition, embracing the unguarded honesty of speaking your heart. At its helm is India’s most popular independent artist, Anuv Jain, pairing delicate guitar work with achingly tender vocals that distill this very emotion into melody. Joining him is Indian electronic duo Lost Stories working their magic on the production of the track as well as performing on the harmonium.
• CREDITS*
Written, Composed, and Performed By: Anuv Jain
